 Saturday's Football Home Finale Sold Out, Standing Room Only Tickets Available
 Story Links
 Game Day Central 
 RIO GRANDE VALLEY  – Saturday's football home finale between The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) Vaqueros and the #3/7/7 Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks, set to kick off at 5 p.m. at Robert & Janet Vackar Stadium, is now sold out, but standing room only tickets remain available for $15. 
A limited number of single-game tickets not claimed by the UTRGV and SFA football teams, in addition to standing room only tickets, were released Friday at 8 a.m. Fans can save and access tickets for entry via Apple or Google Wallet or by logging into your account at  UTRGVTickets.com . All UTRGV football tickets will use NFC scanning, therefore screenshots will not grant entry.
UTRGV has sold out 12 consecutive home games after selling out all seven in the inaugural season and now all five in 2026. The Vaqueros drew a program-record 13,698 in the 2026 season-opener Aug. 29. UTRGV currently leads the Southland and ranks 10 th  in the FCS averaging 12,527 fans through four games. 
This is the third consecutive ranked opponent UTRGV is hosting at Vackar Stadium this season. 
In 2025, the Vaqueros ranked 11 th  in the FCS in total attendance (87,774), 15 th  in average attendance (12,539), and sixth in percentage of capacity (104.49%). Due to high demand, UTRGV expanded the south end zone by approximately 1,500 seats prior to the 2026 season, increasing the overall capacity of Vackar Stadium to 13,498 – up from 12,000. 
Fans without tickets for the game are still able to access the H-E-B Tailgate Zone, tailgate lots, and corporate sponsor tailgate area starting at 12 p.m. Saturday. Visit  RallyTheValley.com  for everything to know about attending a home football game.
